run_terminal_command: run a shell command in a sandboxed terminal environment with configurable timeout and background mode
run_background_task: run a long-running process in the background and get a session_id for later monitoring
run_command_with_watch_patterns: run a background command and watch for specific patterns in the output to trigger notifications
run_command_with_notify_on_complete: run a background task and get automatically notified when it finishes
run_command_in_ptty_mode: run an interactive CLI tool in pseudo-terminal mode for tools like Python REPL
cleanup_all_environments: cleanup all active sandbox environments and orphaned directories
cleanup_vm: cleanup a specific sandbox environment by task_id
check_terminal_requirements: check if all terminal tool requirements are met for the configured environment backend
register_task_env_overrides: register per-task environment overrides for custom Docker or Modal images before agent loop starts
run_command_with_custom_workdir: run a shell command in a specified working directory inside the sandbox
